question: What practice keeps the mind fixed on the Lord while acting?
premises: all actions are dedicated to the Lord
the mind remains fixed on the Lord
inference: dedication plus discernment-yoga sustains constant divine-mindedness
uncertainties: saṃnyasya is read as dedication rather than renunciation
plain_english: Dedicating all actions to me by mind, O Bharata, taking refuge in discernment-yoga, be always of mind fixed on me.
